member.name: T:AnimationSample.Duelist
member.summary: A sparring fighter driven only through its controller's parameters (Sparring.actrl): triggers for attacks, dodges, hits and the knockout (Die), a Block bool, a Dead bool. member.name: T:AnimationSample.RootMotionActor
member.summary: Root motion. The animation component has Apply Root Motion on, so the clips' root bone motion moves the entity itself: the climb lifts the character onto the box, the dashes and the knockback carry it along the lane - no script moves it. This script only plays the states in turn (CrossFade) and puts the character back at its start between performances.

member.name: T:AnimationSample.BlendSpaceStation
member.summary: Blend spaces driven by parameters. The runner's 1D space (Idle - Walk - Jog - Sprint on Speed) sweeps its speed up and down; the knight's 2D directional space (walk / run / strafes / backward on MoveX, MoveY) follows a direction that circles, shown by the arrow at its feet. Every clip in a space plays at one normalized phase, so the feet stay in step through the blend.

member.name: T:AnimationSample.ChainIkStation

Modifiers on plain entities show their solved pose in play mode; in the editor the gizmo previews it.

member.name: T:AnimationSample.CrowdBenchmark
member.summary: The animation scaling benchmark. Spawns a grid of crowd characters, each on the full Hero controller (2D locomotion blend, masked upper-body layer, additive reactions) with foot and look-at IK, and keeps every one busy with its own speed, crouch, aim, sword combos, rolls, jumps and hit reactions, so the profiler's Animation and Rig scopes show what a character costs. Rolls and sword combos move a character by root motion; it walks back to its grid slot afterwards. Up / Down double or halve the crowd, Left / Right change it by CountStep, I turns the IK rigs on or off and F1 the help. SetCount and SetRigs do the same for tools.

members.member: Parameter change per second, so a new speed or crouch blends in instead of popping.
A character a root-motion move (roll, sword combo) carried further than this walks back.
The grid slot and facing the character walks back to after a move carried it away.

member.name: T:AnimationSample.HeroController
member.summary:
The playable hero.
Movement goes through the character controller; the animation controller (Hero.actrl) only gets parameters - Speed / Crouch for the 2D locomotion blend space, Grounded, triggers for jump, roll, dash, the sword combo, pick-up and hit reactions, Aim / AimPitch for the masked upper-body layer. The state machine decides; this script reads it back (IsInTag "Busy") to stop steering mid-attack.
Root motion is on: the sword attacks, their recoveries, the roll and the dash carry their own travel, which the animation system moves through the character controller (so it still collides). Clips the script moves itself - locomotion, jumps, interactions - are imported "Keep In Place". While a Busy state plays the script adds no velocity of its own.
Rig modifiers it drives: Foot IK (weight 0 in the air), the head's Look At IK (target: a character of the station around the hero, marked by the look marker), the left hand's Two Bone IK on the lever (weighted by the clip's HandIK curve, so it needs no script), the sword trail from the clip's Trail curve. The jump leaves the ground on the clip's Takeoff event, through the public method of that name.

member.name: T:AnimationSample.LayerStation
member.summary: Layers. The barbarian walks on the base layer; an override layer masked to the spine and everything above it (arms, head) plays cheer / block / spellcast / interact on top, while its weight swings between 0 and 1 to show the blend; an additive layer adds hit flinches over whatever is playing. Both upper layers rest in an empty state, which fades them out.

member.name: T:AnimationSample.RetargetStation
member.summary: One clip, five skeletons. Every few seconds the next clip crossfades in on all characters at once from script (AnimationComponent.Blend, no controller). The UAL1 rig plays its own clips by copy; the others are Rest Aligned: each bone turns by what its source bone turned from its rest pose, motion scales with hip height, and bones named differently (Rigify, KayKit) are matched by humanoid role. The clips come from three source rigs, so every rig plays clips made for others.

member.name: T:AnimationSample.SpringStation

Bead strands hang from a bar and part around a swinging ball (a sphere collider every strand knows), lanterns sway under a turning beam, and the hero's charm swings as it runs. Stiffness pulls each joint back to its animated direction, damping bleeds speed, gravity drags it down.
